name: Advisor
abilityText: When you provide assistance on a Scholar skill check, the character you are assisting may also roll white dices equal to your ranks in that skill instead of rolling white dices equal to their own ranks in that skill

name: Animal Handler
abilityText: After you perfom an action, you may receive 2 fatigue to have any number of you animal companions each take an action that shares a type with your action (your animal's actions are still limited to taking one action of each type per round.)

name: Ashigaru
abilityText: When you provide assistance on the Martial Arts [Melee] Attack action check of another character at range 0-2, the character you are assisting treats their target's physical resistance as 1 lower for each assisting character with this ability.

name: Astradhari
abilityText: You can purchase mantra techniques

name: Bond with a Spirit
abilityText: Once per scene, after you have received fatigue or strife due to an enemy's Attack or Scheme action, that enemy suffers the same amount of strife or fatigue you received.

name: Castellan
abilityText: When undertaking a downtime activity to prepare your castle for an important event (a wedding, a battle, or a Winter Court, for example), you may change all rolled blank results to Opportunity results.

name: Clan Magistrate
abilityText: When you make a Command or Courtesy check targeting a member of your clan, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: The target receives or removes (your choice) strife equal to Opportunities spent this way

name: Covert Agent
abilityText: When you make a check to deceive or hide from someone, you may negate up to 2 Strife symbols.

name: Daimyō
abilityText: Reduce the TN of Command checks you make targeting your vassals by 1

name: The Damned
abilityText: Increase the TN of all your non-Command Social skill checks by 1, and reduce the TN of all your Martial Arts [Any] skill checks targeting Tainted beings by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-Tainted beings receive 1 strife whenever they make a Social skill check targeting you

name: Deathseeker
abilityText: As a Support action, you may suffer the Enraged condition. While you are Enraged, you can perform Attack actions even while Incapacitated.

name: Doomhunter
abilityText: When you perform an Attack action, you can spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: You attempt to ascertain your target's mortal weaknesses through practised study of its combat decisions. It must resist with Sentiment check to conceal the means by which it can be defeated. The TN of this check is equal to your ranks in Survival plus Opportunities spent this way (Air+2, Fire-2). If your target's check fails, you learn one key clue to defeating it permanently. If you already know how to defeat it, reduce the TN of your next check against it by 2.

name: Dreaded Enforcer
abilityText: When making a check to plan an assassination or attack with lethal intent, you may negate up to 2 Strife symbols.

name: Elemental Guard
abilityText: Choose one: Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. This is your elemental specialty. Once per scene after making a Martial skill check that uses the ring of your elemental specialty, you may inflict an amount of strife or panic equal to your ranks in the ring associated with your elemental specialty against a target at range 0-3 or a cohort in the scene.

name: Elemental Legionnaire
abilityText: Choose one: Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. This is your elemental specialty. Once per scene after making a Martial skill check that uses the ring of your elemental specialty, you and a number of targets at range 0-3 (or other cohort leaders in the scene) up to your ranks in Command may remove strife equal to your ranks in the ring associated with your elemental specialty.

name: Emerald Magistrate
abilityText: Once per game session when making a Scheme or Support action check using a Social skill, you may choose additional targets equal to your Glory rank. You cannot choose any additional target with vigilance higher than the highest among your initial targets.

name: Esteemed Negotiator
abilityText: Once per scene, as a Scheme and Support action, you may reduce the strife of all characters in the scene by your ranks in Sentiment.

name: General
abilityText: While you are the commander of an army during a mass battle, your army's discipline value is increased by your ranks in Command. Additionally, when making an Initiative check during a mass battle, increase the result by your ranks in Tactics.

name: Ghostlands Warrior
abilityText: When you make a check to see through supernatural illusion, reduce the TN of the check by 1. If you are in Defiled terrain, reduce the TN by 2 instead.

name: Gunsō
abilityText: When you defeat an opponent in a clash, your cohort removes panic equal to the opponent’s glory rank. Once per round when you succeed at an Attack action check during a mass battle, your cohort removes panic equal to half of the attrition you inflict

name: Harvester
abilityText: Reduce the TN of your Survival checks to track down a Tainted being by 1. When you inflict a critical strike on a Tainted being, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 2: The target suffers the Dazed, Disoriented, or Immobilized condition

name: Imperial Peacekeeper
abilityText: Once per scene as a Support action, you can choose a number of characters up to your ranks in Command and demand that they pull themselves together. Each chosen character removes 3 strife.

name: In a Service to a Lord
abilityText: Once per session, when acting in your lord’s interest, you may use their status rank as your own.

name: Interpreter
abilityText: You learn the languages (written, spoken, signed, and any other forms, as relevant) of the group for which you are an interpreter. Additionaly, the first time you make a check to interact socially with a member of this group each encounter, reduce the TN by 1.

name: Kenshinzen
abilityText: When you perform an Attack action that uses a sheathed Razor-Edged weapon, you may spend Opportunities as follows: Void 2: Your target cannot defend against the damage from this Attack action unless they spend a Void point. Any 1: After you perform this action, you may sheathe the weapon you used

name: Kyuden Asako Shieldbreaker
abilityText: After an Attack action check targeting you fails, the attacker suffers strife equal to their shortfall.

name: Lion's Pride Warrior
abilityText: Once per scene, when you deal damage to a target or deal attrition to an enemy leader's cohort, increase the damage or attrition by an amount equal to the difference between your honor rank and the target's honor rank.

name: Master Artisan
abilityText: When crafting an item, you may spend Opportunies as follows: 3: The item you create is a singular masterwork. You must give it a name befitting its status. Once per game session when making a check that uses the item, a character may add 1 black dice set to any result of their choice

name: Master Saboteur
abilityText: When a fortification's difficulty value would be reduced during a mass battle, the value is lowered by that amount plus your ranks in Labor instead. If there is a cohort occupying it, that cohort's army suffers panic equal to your ranks in Skulduggery.

name: Monastic Acolyte
abilityText: When you are selected as a target of an action requiring a skill check, you may spend a Void point to increase or decrease the TN of the check by an amount up to your ranks in Meditation (to a minimum of 1)

name: Moon Cultist
abilityText: Once per game session as an Attack and Scheme action, you may make a Theology (Water) check targeting a character at range 0-1. The TN of the check is equal to the target's vigilance. If you succeed, choose one ring. Your target treats the value of that ring as reduced by half (to a minimum of 1), and you treat that ring as increased by the amount their ring was reduced. Your and your target's derived attributes change according to these changes (see page 36 of the core rulebook). This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to your Void Ring.

name: Perfect Land Sect Member
abilityText: When making a social skill check targeting a character with status 20 or lower, reduce the TN by 1.

name: Poet of War
abilityText: After you perform a successful Rally action, the targeted cohort deals 1 additional attrition when its leader performs a successful Attack action check. This effect persists for one round.

name: Priest
abilityText: You may importune invocations even if you do not know any invocations. When you importune an invocation, do not increase the TN by 1 (although you still increase the TN if the rank of the invocation is higher than your school rank)

name: Quartermaster
abilityText: When you make a check as a downtime activity to provision an army, you may spend Opportunity as follows: 1+: If you succeed, your army increases its discipline and strength each by 1 per Opportunity spent this way. This effect persists until the end of the next mass battle scene.

name: Renowed Warrior
abilityText: Once per scene, after you make a successful Martial Arts check that inflicts fatigue or a critical strike on the target, you may have each friendly character at range 0-3 of you or the target remove an amount of strife equal to the TN of the check.

name: Scarlet Banners Ranger
abilityText: When you make a Martial Arts [Melee] or Martial Arts [Ranged] Attack action check using a Snaring weapon, add 1 kept Skill dice set to Success and Opportunity

name: Seven Fold Palace Acolyte
abilityText: When you make a check to craft an item, you may suffer a number of fatigue up to your ranks in Fitness. If you do, change that many results containing Success to Opportunity results.

name: Spirit Caller
abilityText: Once per game session as a Support action, you may spend 1 Void point to summon the spirit of an ancestor to partially possess you until the end of the scene. Choose a ring and a skill from that ancestor's profile; while possessed, you count as an Otherworldly being and use your ancestor's ring value and skill rank in place of your own, as well as your ancestor's honor value. Your ancestor can use any non-unique human NPC profile (or a kitsu's or other supernatural being's profile, if your character has such an ancestor). The higher of this NPC's Combat conflict rank and Intrigue conflict rank cannot exceed your school rank plus your ranks in Meditation. While you are possessed, the ancestor spirit may divulge pertinent information at the GM's discretion. Afterward, your character will have only a hazy memory of anything they experienced while possessed.

name: Spirit Hunter
abilityText: Reduce the TN of your Attack and Scheme action checks targeting Otherworldly beings by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Spy
abilityText: Once per game session as a Scheme and Support action or as a downtime activity targeting a particular location or social group, you may gather and sift through the current rumors for credible intelligence by making a TN 4 Sentiment (Air) check. If you succeed, you discover the latest happenings relevant to your current location or social group, as well as which current rumors are false. If discerning someone’s qualities is your social objective in an intrigue scene, you score momentum points equal to your Air Ring plus your bonus successes. Opportunity: You plant a rumor that spreads among the characters in the scene or the targeted group (although they don’t necessarily believe it).

name: Student of Names
abilityText: You are learned in the Way of Names and can wield the sorcerous art called meishōdō. In addition to the new options this grants you Otherworldly Encounters, this title ability lets you sustain one meishōdō talisman of your own creation. If you create a second meishōdō talisman, you must choose one of the two talismans and release the spirit within it.

name: Sumai Master
abilityText: When you make a Martial Arts [Unarmed] check targeting another character, if your Void ring is higher than or equal to your target's Void ring, reduce the TN by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Sword-Saint
abilityText: When you perform an Attack or Support action check that uses a sword, you may spend Opportunities as follows: Void 1+: Reduce the severity of the next critical strike you would suffer (before your Fitness check to resist) by your ranks in Meditation plus 1 per Opportunity spent this way. This effect persists until the start of your next turn. Any 2: Increase the base damage and deadliness of your weapon by 3. This effect persists until the end of the scene. If you activate this Opportunities multiple times during a scene, the effect is cumulative (add together all increases you have applied this scene with this Opportunities).

name: Twenty-Goblin Crab
abilityText: When making a Martial Arts [Any] check targeting a goblin, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: Each other goblin at range 0–2 of your target receives 1 strife per Opportunity that you spend this way

name: War College Graduate
abilityText: During a mass battle, when you accrue 1 or more momentum points toward the Draw Them In or Seize Victory strategic objective, you accrue that many momentum points plus 1 instead. Additionally, if your action completes that strategic objective, the enemy army receives additional casualties and panic equal to your ranks in Tactics.

name: White Guard Veteran
abilityText: When you receive strife due to the effect of an Otherworldly or Tainted being, reduce the strife you gain by your ranks in Meditation. When another character makes a check to resist an effect of an Attack action you perform (including a check to resist a critical strike you inflict as a part of the attack), increase the TN of the check to resist by 1.

name: Winter Court Champion
abilityText: When making a check to boast or get people’s attention, you may negate up to 2 Strife symbols.

name: Witch Hunter
abilityText: When you make a check to resist the effects of a mahō technique, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1: Reduce the TN of your next check targeting the mahō practitioner who performed it by 1 per Opportunity spent this way. 2: If you succeed on the check to resist, the mahō practitioner receives strife equal to your ranks in Theology

name: Yōjimbō
abilityText: One character is assigned as your charge; this character can order you to treat someone else as your charge instead until they lift this order. If your charge is at range 0–2, you may spend 1 Void point to replace your charge as the target of an Attack action. If you suffer a critical strike as a result of this Attack action, gain 1 Void point.

name: Yoriki
abilityText: When you make an Attack action using a weapon with the Snaring quality, you may alter any number of kept dice containing Success or Exploding Success to results set to Opportunity.

name: Lord Bayushi's Aide-de-camp
abilityText: You may spend 1 Void Point to increase TN of check targeting you made by members of the Scorpion clan by 2, until the end of scene. When you make a Command or Courtesy check targeting a member of Scorpion clan other than Lord Bayushi or his other aide-de-camps, you may spend Opportunities as follows: 1+: The target receives or removes (your choice) strife equal to Opportunities spent this way
